_comment: Labeled recall cases for the momento eval harness. Each case: a query a user might type, and an `expect` substring that must appear (case-insensitive) in a hit's project_path, summary, or first_prompt for that hit to count as relevant. Cases are authored against Charlie's real ~/.momento index. `kind` tags the gap each case probes so the harness can report per-gap recall.

cases.note: bare near-miss token: user types 27, corpus says WWDC26 — isolates the fuzzy gap with no other carrying tokens
multi-token; other words carry it even without fuzzy
VRP == bug bounty; needs synonym expansion
